prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This silver-blue kitten artwork is the exact edit target. There is one accidental shape change to fix: the pale yellow decorations printed on the blanket should ALL be ordinary FIVE-POINT STARS, not crescent moons. Replace each pale yellow crescent on the blanket with a five-point star of the same pale yellow, at the same printed-decoration location and same approximate size. Keep every existing white and yellow five-point star unchanged. There must be no crescent shapes on the blanket. Change NOTHING ELSE: preserve kitten face, fur markings, eyes, paws, pencil, paper with outlined star, blanket outline and folds, all object positions and scales, silver-blue/milk-white/moon-yellow palette, white margins, clean cel linework, 1448×1086 exact 4:3 canvas. Do not change colors, zoom, crop, add props, add text, watermark, border, texture, blur or grain.
